name: vanigtm
description: VaNi — the API and agent core (backend/), the console (vani-app/), the website (web/)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix vani-app install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names api,worker,ui --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:ui && npm run build:web
